e2_leak_calibration_provenance.note: The registered freeze calibration remains the operative leak bound; the later instrument-closure lane is provenance, not a replacement calibration.

e2_tipping_point.note: Tool-channel stops occur only in C and D. The judge's measured false-positive rate is 1.00 on tool-channel gold negatives (n=7) against 0.49 on prose (n=79), so a share of C's positives may be instrument leniency rather than behaviour. The bound is deterministic: this many verdicts would have to reverse to erase the difference.
